question.text: What is the full form of SID in mutual funds?

explanation.text: The Logic: SID stands for Scheme Information Document. It is the main document that tells you everything about a mutual fund scheme — its objective, where it invests, fees, risks, and more. The Trap: The other options sound similar but are not real terms used in the mutual fund industry. Always remember: SID = Scheme Information Document. Cross-Exam Context: Also tested in Series V-A. SID is the most frequently tested document name. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Think of SID as the "identity card" of a mutual fund scheme. Before recommending any scheme, read its SID carefully.
